notes.title: Demo v31 dropped
notes.content: v31 of the demo is now available. A new level has been added that pits the player against a spreading infestation. Defeat the infestation by covering it with stones before things get out of hand.

notes.title: Demo version v25 out now.
notes.content:
Plagues, Famine, Lightning, Volcanoes, Fire, New block types.
5 levels, Hours of world building.
Ten languages including Chinese, Russian & Japanese.

notes.title: Demo now available.
notes.content:
A solid demo of Plentiful is now available.
It has a quick tutorial and 4 fully playable levels.
roughly 3 hours of gameplay.

This demo contains all the main gameplay features.
Modifiable land
Water simulation
Procedural trees that grow depending on the environment
People and animals
Weather
Music
